page_title: LIV 2-1 WOL | Liverpool v Wolves 27/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Simon Hooper has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' CHANCE! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
90+3' A substitution has been made. Florian Wirtz is replaced by Trey Nyoni (Liverpool).
90+2' The game is interrupted. Joao Gomes (Wolves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+2' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) commits a rough foul. Simon Hooper stops the game and makes a call.
88' Andre (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
88' The ball is cleared after Matheus Mane (Wolves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
87' Andre (Wolves) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
87' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' Here is a change. Hugo Ekitike is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
84' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the left post.
81' Matheus Mane (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Alisson comes off his line to gather the ball.
79' Substitution. Yerson Mosquera will be replaced by Jhon Arias (Wolves).

78' What an opportunity! Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
76' A short through ball almost allows Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.

74' Matheus Mane (Wolves) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Alisson pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
73' It looks like Matheus Mane (Wolves) saw red with that tackle. Simon Hooper won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
72' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!

70' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
70' Simon Hooper has a clear sight and sees a foul from Andre (Wolves). Liverpool are awarded the free kick.
67' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
66' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
65' Great save! Curtis Jones (Liverpool) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Jose Sa.
65' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
62' Rob Edwards decides to make a substitution. Hugo Bueno will be replaced by David Moller Wolfe (Wolves).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Bueno trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves).
62' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) replacing Matt Doherty.
61' The substitution is prepared. Conor Bradley (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Federico Chiesa.

61' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
61' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner.
56' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
56' The foul by Andre (Wolves) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simon Hooper.
51' 2 - 1 Goal! Santiago Bueno (Wolves) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 2:1.

51' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
51' There's an opportunity for Andre (Wolves) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
51' A pass into the penalty area from Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) is intercepted by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
51' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) brings his opponent down. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
49' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
45+1' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Hugo Ekitike sets up Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
41' 1 - 0 Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
40' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
37' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
35' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
33' Matheus Mane (Wolves) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
32' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) makes a strong challenge and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
30' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

30' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' The linesman signals that Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
28' OFF THE POST! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
26' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
25' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
25' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) steps up to send the ball in.
25' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Liverpool have a corner.
24' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

20' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
19' Dangerous play by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves). Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.

18' Matheus Mane (Wolves) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Alisson, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
16' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
15' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
13' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
12' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) will deliver the corner kick.
11' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
10' Great teamplay by Liverpool as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

7' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
6' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
5' Simon Hooper interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Joao Gomes (Wolves).
2' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simon Hooper.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
